title: Ensuring Deployment-Time Safety of Neural Network Controlled Systems via Localized Certificate Repair
abstract: arXiv:2611.33813v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Barrier certificates provide formal safety guarantees for neural network controlled systems by ensuring that system trajectories avoid unsafe regions over time. However, after deployment, previously unseen obstacles or constraint changes may introduce new unsafe regions, invalidating the original certificate and potentially leading to unsafe behavior. We address this setting with adaptive piecewise barrier certificates, which preserve the original certificate and policy in unchanged regions while introducing localized updates around newly emerged unsafe regions. The central question is how to perform such updates efficiently during system execution without retraining from scratch. Our key idea is to cast deployment-time adaptation as a localized certificate repair problem and reduce it to an optimization task that leverages the learned structure of previous barrier certificates, enabling fast updates without global retraining. translated_title: 通过局部化证书修复保障神经网络控制系统的部署时安全
translated_abstract: 屏障证书通过确保系统轨迹随时间避开不安全区域，为神经网络控制系统提供形式化安全保证。然而，在部署之后，先前未曾见过的障碍物或约束变化可能引入新的不安全区域，使原有证书失效，进而可能导致不安全行为。我们针对这一场景提出自适应分段屏障证书，其在未发生变化的区域保留原有证书与策略，同时在新出现的不安全区域周围引入局部化更新。核心问题在于如何在不从头重新训练的情况下，在系统运行过程中高效地完成此类更新。我们的关键思想是将部署时自适应建模为一个局部化证书修复问题，并将其转化为一个优化任务，该任务利用先前屏障证书所学习到的结构，从而无需全局重训即可实现快速更新。
tldr: 提出自适应分段屏障证书方法，将部署时的安全自适应转化为局部化证书修复优化问题，在保留未变区域原有证书与策略的同时，对新增不安全区域进行快速局部更新，无需全局重训。
en_tdlr: Proposes adaptive piecewise barrier certificates that cast deployment-time adaptation as a localized certificate repair optimization, enabling fast updates around newly emerged unsafe regions without global retraining while preserving the original certificate and policy elsewhere.
